title: Welling Emergency Help Points
summary: A&E options, urgent treatment centres, and local geographical hazards for Welling and DA16.
content:
Life-threatening emergencies are always 999 first. Dial NHS 111 for non-emergency medical advice.

1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals:
- Queen Elizabeth Hospital, Stadium Road, Woolwich SE18 4QH. From Welling Corner: ~2.5 miles west; take bus 89 or 486 west straight along Bellegrove Road and Shooters Hill Road (~20 min ride).
- Princess Royal University Hospital, Farnborough Common, Orpington BR6 8ND. Approx. 7 miles south via A222.
- King's College Hospital, Denmark Hill, Camberwell SE5 9RS (Nearest Major Trauma Centre).

2. Urgent Treatment Centres:
- Queen Mary's Urgent Treatment Centre, Queen Mary's Hospital, Frognal Avenue, Sidcup DA14 6LT. Open 24/7. From Welling station: ~3 miles south; take bus 51 towards Orpington/Sidcup (~20 min ride).
- Erith Urgent Treatment Centre, Erith Hospital, Park Crescent, Erith DA8 3EE. Open daily 08:00–20:00. From Welling: ~3 miles east; take bus B15 or B16 towards Bexleyheath/Erith.

3. Local Hazards & Flood Risks:
- The River Shuttle corridor runs south of Welling, bringing localized surface runoff and fluvial flood risks in heavy downpours.
- The busy A2 (East Rochester Way) borders the south of Welling and can hinder north-south movement during infrastructure closures.

4. Supplies & Essentials:
- Pharmacies, grocery stores, and larger retail outlets along Bellegrove Road, Welling High Street, and Upper Wickham Lane supply first-aid goods, packaged water, and emergency hygiene items.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
